_note: RAG eval cases, run against each corpus in corpora/. `set`: original = the 34 prompts of data/rag_eval.json (the current retriever's thresholds were hand-fit to these), heldout = written for this eval and never used for tuning. `gold`: the passages the model needs, each identified by `needles`, short verbatim snippets of the section body (any one present in what the model sees = passage delivered). Bodies are identical in every corpus, so the needles hold whatever the headings or chunker. `section` and `file` are for humans only. An empty `gold` is a negative control: no notes should be injected. `facts`: regexes a correct answer must all match (case-insensitive, after normalize() in run.py). `route` is the route the prompt is meant for (informational; not scored). Facts are matched line by line. Never change a prompt after a baseline run: compare.py refuses runs whose prompts differ. Gold and facts may be refined, since every run is re-scored with the current file when it is loaded.
